summaries.summary: The page defines weaving as the fabric manufacturing technology involving interlacing warp and weft yarns to produce cloth or fabric, and clarifies that fabric is a technical term while cloth is a commercial term. It further defines fabric as a manufactured assembly of fibres or yarns with substantial surface area relative to thickness and sufficient cohesion to provide useful mechanical strength.
key_facts: Weaving is the process of fabric manufacturing technology.
Cloth is produced by interlacing warp and weft yarns.
Fabric is a technical term for a manufactured assembly of fibres or yarns with substantial surface area and sufficient cohesion for mechanical strength.
Cloth is a commercial term for the same assembly.
visible_text: Weaving: Weaving is the process of fabric manufacturing technology.
The final product of weaving i.e. cloth or fabric is obtained by interlacing of warp & weft yarns disposed in perpendicular direction.
Fabric or Cloth: Fabric is a technical term and cloth is a commercial term.
A fabric is a manufactured assembly of fibres or yarns that has substantial surface area in relation to its thickness and sufficient cohesion to give the assembly useful mechanical strength.

Weaving mechanism includes: Tappet, Dobby, Jacquard.
Knitting includes: Warp knitting and Weft knitting.
